assessment: Recovered author body. Extension of the Hansen poison-center series and same four-dog kernel exposure. Acute field tremor and no observed tremor in experimentally exposed dogs.
Lamb dietary oil and vitamin E comparison. Growth, composition and blood outcomes. No tremor phenotyping.
Oil-blend heating and chemical peroxidation. No administration or clinical outcome.
Same titled study as PMID:37120222. Count as one primary lipid study family.
Macadamia estate is the place of employment. Exposures are pesticides, not macadamia oil.
Original abstract plus 2002 author report. Same kernel poison center series and four experimentally exposed dogs. Acute signs differ from frozen phenotype.
Primary abstract. Macadamia oil was a topical control for nickel dermatitis and had no significant effect on the measured skin outcomes.
Macadamia oil compared with several other oils in hamsters. Lipoproteins and aortic cholesterol. No movement measure.
Opinion on developmental disorders and omega-3. No administered macadamia oil or rest-tremor comparison. Near-duplicate lineage of PMID:22141191.

Checked Bousquet thesis Chapter 3 and linked Chapter 2 diet table. The DHA comparison has feeding and Parkinson-model context. Table 2-1 lists fats including corn and canola oils without macadamia oil.
Veterinary toxicology review. No new independent oral oil or Parkinson contrast identified.
Near-duplicate of the hypothesis paper at PMID:19326737. No independent oil experiment.
Author abstract verified on PubMed and publisher. Both family-history groups ate the oil meal. Endpoints are metabolic and gene-expression measures. Full tables unavailable.
Australian plant antimicrobial screen considers bacterial triggers and rheumatoid arthritis. No clinical movement contrast.
Animal dietary arm explicitly uses macadamia-nut oil. The primary outcomes are diet-induced liver fat and related metabolism, without movement assessment.
Author-hosted full paper. Table 1 lists oil sources without macadamia. Figure 1 motor behavior remains unchanged with DHA despite dopamine and tissue findings.
Veterinary household food review. Macadamia kernels and acute signs with no independent food-oil comparison.
The tested kernel is Pindan walnut. Macadamia provides food chemistry context or comparison, with no administered macadamia oil for movement.
Plant pathogen lineage study. Macadamia occurs in plant-disease context, without culinary oil intervention.
Original full human RRIPP-3 report uses macadamia-oil comparator. Cognitive, resilience and mood measures with attrition and no reported rest tremor.
PDQoL7 validation in Parkinson disease. The reported comparison is between quality-of-life measures, without oil exposure.
Culinary oil thermal oxidation study. Chemical products rather than a symptom response.
Macadamia oil in cells and high-fat-fed mice. Lipid and oxidative outcomes. Same bibliographic study as AGR:IND608338119. Check population overlap separately for PMID:39594087.
Primary characterization of marula seed oil. Oil identity differs from macadamia, and no movement is recorded.
Macadamia oil cake in hyperlipidemic rats. The by-product differs from expressed oil, and outcomes are microbial and metabolic.
Original RRIPP-3 companion analysis. Baseline personality and persistence/graduation association, not an independent oil cohort or movement result.
Proteaceae phytochemistry synthesis. Secondary context without a new original Parkinson oil comparison.
Rabbit feeding experiment. Growth, serum and thyroid measures; no rest-tremor outcome.
Macadamia oil and high-fat-fed mouse liver or lipid outcomes. No neurological endpoint in the author abstract. Do not count as independent corroboration of any motor effect.
Original abstract and publisher preview. Rat chemical brain injury tissue outcomes, no accessible movement result. Body and exposure details remain open.
Original abstract examines plasma lipid composition and early Huntington motor scores. No assignment to macadamia oil or Parkinson resting phenotype.

Primary pages 656–662 visually checked. Formulated drinks and margarines produce lipid comparisons and two transient GI complaints during the macadamia-rich period. Pressing grade and rest tremor unreported.
